**Blend:** Fortune 500 80% + Annual Report 20%  
**Temperature:** 4/10 (cool) · **Formality:** 9/10 · **Tags:** professional  
**Perfect for:** Fortune 500, Enterprise Corporations, Major Businesses

## Content fundamentals

- Write for members and staff of the organization: direct, formal and composed.
- Headings name the thing plainly: “Investor Resources”, “Shareholder Information”, “IR Document Library”, “Earnings Calendar”.
- Buttons are short verb phrases in Title Case: “Email Alerts”, “Contact IR”, “View Filing”, “View Filing”.
- Navigation uses single nouns: “Overview”, “Stock Information”, “Financial Reports”, “SEC Filings”, “Events & Presentations”, “Corporate Governance”.
- The reference page uses emoji as inline glyphs (👥 📄 📅 ©); keep them functional, never decorative.

## Color

- Set the page on `page-bg` with body text in `page-text`. The theme is light.
- Identity colours: `primary-blue`, `primary-blue-light`. Lead with the first; use the rest for accents and emphasis.
- Status colours (`success-green`, `success-light`, `danger-red`) always travel with a word or icon; never signal state by hue alone.
- Each token's note says where the reference page uses it and, for text colours, its contrast on `page-bg`. Keep body text at 4.5:1 or better.

## Typography

- `display` — Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

Faces are hosted on Google Fonts (Inter); load them with:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap">
```

- Set titles in `display`, sections in `heading-2` and running text in `body`.
- Uppercase is reserved for small labels (`heading-4`, `label`), always with the letter-spacing given.

## Spacing, shape and elevation

- Spacing steps: `space-4` 4px, `space-8` 8px, `space-12` 12px, `space-16` 16px, `space-20` 20px, `space-24` 24px. Pad cards and sections from these steps only.
- Corners: `radius-4` 4px.
- Elevation: `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, lowest first for resting cards, higher for hover and overlays.

- Style Blend: Fortune 500 Enterprise (80%) + Annual Report Aesthetics (20%)
- Target Audience: Institutional investors, shareholders, financial analysts
- Brand Position: Enterprise credibility, financial transparency, corporate trust

- VISUAL HIERARCHY STRUCTURE

- Color Strategy - Corporate Authority:
- Primary Blue (#1e40af)    - Trust, stability, corporate identity
- White (#ffffff)           - Clarity, transparency, professionalism
- Success Green (#059669)   - Positive performance, growth indicators
- Neutral Gray (#6b7280)    - Supporting text, subtle backgrounds

- Typography System - Professional Precision:
- Font Family: Inter         - Corporate standard, maximum legibility
- Heading Weights: 600-700   - Executive authority
- Body Weights: 400-500      - Clear communication
- Letter Spacing: -0.02em    - Premium tightness
- Line Height: 1.4-1.6       - Report readability

- Spatial Organization - Structured Data Flow:
- Grid System: 4-column stats, 3-column content
- Card Spacing: 24px gaps    - Organized separation
- Section Padding: 64px      - Report-style breathing room
- Border Radius: 4px         - Minimal, professional
- Container Width: 1280px    - Annual report standard

- COMPONENT ARCHITECTURE

- Financial Metrics Cards (4):
- Stock Price & Change       - Real-time performance indicator
- Market Capitalization      - Company valuation
- Annual Revenue             - Financial scale
- Earnings Per Share         - Shareholder value metric

- Visual Design:
- Clean white backgrounds with subtle shadow elevation
- Corporate blue accent borders on hover
- Green/red color coding for positive/negative metrics
- Large numeric displays with clear labels
- Percentage changes with directional indicators

- Content Cards (3):
- Shareholder Information    - Executive portraits, contact info
- IR Documents Library       - Downloadable reports, presentations
- Earnings Calendar          - Upcoming events, dates, times

- Architecture:
- Consistent card heights for visual harmony
- Icon-driven navigation within cards
- Hierarchical content structure
- Call-to-action buttons with corporate blue

- Data Table - Recent SEC Filings:
- Column Structure: Filing Type, Description, Date, Action
- Zebra Striping: Subtle gray alternating rows
- Interactive Rows: Hover state for engagement
- Action Buttons: Download/view functionality

- EMOTIONAL RESONANCE MAPPING

- Temperature: Cool Professional (4/10)
- Measured, controlled, authoritative
- Trust-building through consistency
- No emotional manipulation, pure transparency

- Formality: Very High Corporate (9/10)
- Executive boardroom standards
- Institutional investor expectations
- SEC compliance aesthetic alignment

- Trust Signals:
- ✓ Clean, uncluttered layouts
- ✓ Precise numerical data
- ✓ Professional photography
- ✓ Consistent branding elements
- ✓ Accessible document libraries
- ✓ Clear contact pathways

## States and motion

- Micro-interactions:
- Hover States: Subtle elevation, blue accent reveals
- Transition Speed: 0.2s - Professional, not playful
- Shadow Depth: Minimal - Suggestion, not distraction
- Button States: Clear active/inactive differentiation

- Navigation Patterns:
- Top-level: Investor-centric menu structure
- Call-to-Actions: High-contrast, action-oriented
- Footer: Comprehensive IR resource access

- Accessibility Standards:
- WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance
- High contrast ratios (7:1 minimum for body text)
- Semantic HTML structure
- Keyboard navigation support
- Screen reader optimization

- RESPONSIVE BEHAVIOR

- Breakpoint Strategy:
- Desktop (1280px+): Full 4-column grid
- Tablet (768px-1279px): 2-column responsive grid
- Mobile (320px-767px): Single column stack

- Component Adaptation:
- Stats cards: Maintain visual weight across viewports
- Data table: Horizontal scroll on mobile
- Navigation: Hamburger menu below 768px

- BRAND ALIGNMENT PRINCIPLES

- Fortune 500 Corporate Standards (80%):
- ✓ Institutional credibility through clean design
- ✓ Financial data clarity and precision
- ✓ Executive-level professionalism
- ✓ Shareholder-centric information architecture

- Annual Report Aesthetics (20%):
- ✓ Report-style content organization
- ✓ Data table prominence
- ✓ Document library emphasis
- ✓ Structured hierarchy with clear sections

- PERFORMANCE CONSIDERATIONS

- Single Google Fonts load (Inter family)
- No JavaScript dependencies
- Pure CSS animations
- Optimized for fast render on institutional networks
- Print-friendly layout structure

- SUCCESS METRICS

- User Goals Supported:
- ✓ Quickly assess stock performance
- ✓ Access quarterly earnings information
- ✓ Download investor documents
- ✓ Contact investor relations team
- ✓ Review upcoming corporate events

- Design Effectiveness Indicators:
- Time to key metric: <3 seconds
- Document access: 2 clicks maximum
- Contact pathway: 1 click from any page
- Mobile usability score: 95+
- Accessibility score: 100

Timing values: `--transition` all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1).

- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop lifts and transitions to instant state changes.

## Iconography

- Inline SVG line icons on a 24×24 viewBox, 2px stroke, drawn in `currentColor` so they take the text colour around them.
- No logo ships with this style: set the organization name in the `display` style.

## Accessibility

- `page-text` on `page-bg` measures 10.3:1.
- Every interactive element shows a visible focus state at 3:1 or better against its surface.
- Measured on `page-bg`, these text colours reach 3:1 but not 4.5:1: `success-green` 3.8:1. Use them on `page-bg` only for large text (24px+, or bold 19px+), whatever the design notes below claim.
- These fall under 3:1 on `page-bg`: `white` 1.0:1. Never set text in them on `page-bg`, at any size; use them as text only on a fill whose measured pairing meets 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).

## Not synced

Built from `style-60-fortune-500.html`. No component bundle: the reference page's markup is not packaged as live components.
